name: 1967 AFL Championship
summary: Oakland defeated Houston 40-7 to win the 1967 AFL Championship and advance to Super Bowl II.

name: Super Bowl XI
summary: The Raiders defeated Minnesota 32-14 for the franchise's first Super Bowl championship. Fred Biletnikoff was named MVP.

name: Super Bowl XV
summary: Oakland defeated Philadelphia 27-10. The Raiders became the first Wild Card team to win the Super Bowl, and Jim Plunkett earned MVP honors.

name: Super Bowl XVIII
summary: Los Angeles defeated Washington 38-9 for the franchise's third Super Bowl title. Marcus Allen was MVP after rushing for 191 yards.
